schema.description: Declares a LocationType legal (Allow) or illegal (Deny) in matching zones.

ruleId.description: The rule's identity. Named verbatim in the rejection error it causes.

effect.description: Deny always wins. Any Allow rule matching a zone turns that zone into an allow-list.

zone.description: Selects the zones a PlacementRule applies to. Every field set must match (AND); unset fields are wildcards; at least one must be set — an empty predicate constrains nothing and is rejected with 422.

zoneCode.description: Match only zones with this zone code. An empty string is not a predicate — it is rejected like an absent one.

temperatureClass.description: A zone's thermal behaviour. PlacementRules match on it.
temperatureClass.title: TemperatureClass

hazmat.description: Match only zones whose hazmat flag equals this value.

zone.title: ZonePredicate

description.description: Human-readable rendering of the rule, as it appears in error details.

schema.title: PlacementRule

404.description: The named site, zone, aisle, slot, location type or placement rule does not exist.

schema.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details. Every error response in this API uses this shape.

type.description: A URI identifying the error CATEGORY. It is an identifier, not a link — it does not need to resolve.

title.description: A fixed, human-readable summary of the error category.
title.example: Location type is not legal in this zone

status.description: The HTTP status code, duplicated in the body per RFC 7807.

detail.description: The specific message for this occurrence.
detail.example: location type violates a placement rule for this zone: Shelf is denied in zone WH1-STOR-FRZ by rule [RULE-FRZ-NO-SHELF: Deny Shelf where temperatureClass=Frozen]

instance.description: The request path that produced the error.

schema.title: Problem
